items.title: Menu rework: buttons going missing
items.body: Player request F#5 (2026-07-08). Buttons going missing is annoying - do the menu rework soon. Bumps the menu-framework-coupled-to-views MVP item / [[discord-interaction-layer]].

items.title: Player-founded structures become real locations
items.body: Player request F#4, B#8 (Ulrich's temple). A player who starts building a temple expects it to exist as its own explorable/buildable place, not resolve to an existing/adjacent location. Relates to lazy world growth + world-state tracking [[mvp-data-model]].

items.title: Cross-player buff actions
items.body: Player request B#11. Praying/blessing "for everyone" should apply a buff mutation to the other players present, not no-op. Needs a multiplayer-aware mutation.

items.title: Items should be usable, not stat-bonus clutter
items.body: Player request F#11. Players accumulate notes/keys/etc. that only grant a passive stat bonus and never get used; make items actually do something. Tracked in [[improved-item-features]].

items.title: Communal / offering currency separate from personal gold
items.body: Player request F#9. A player wanted to spend offering-basket funds (not their own coin) on temple supplies; distinguish a shared/temple purse from personal wealth. Nuance under the MVP "make wealth spendable/meaningful" item.

items.title: Re-evaluate periodic channel messages
items.body: Any periodic channel message should be re-evaluated.

items.title: Menu framework coupled to views
items.body: Standardise the views/command/message terminology and a tab/subtab layout per message. See [[discord-interaction-layer]] (subtabs are explicitly MVP there).

items.title: Make wealth/stamina/health spendable and meaningful; define death / 0 HP
items.body: Death track deferred from POC by design ([[the-poc]]); see [[mvp-progression]] (lifecycle/death), [[mvp-combat]] (HP stakes), [[mvp+npc-economy]] (wealth sink).

items.title: Cap rolls per action type + short-rest option; reward slow build-up
items.body: Reward slow build-up / daily-work play on subsequent actions instead of jumping straight in. Check for hard-coded roll caps. Extends [[roll-economy-timeouts-and-world-growth]].

items.title: Character progression depth
items.body: Levels, upskilling, traits; the char creator shows which stats matter per race/class and how each modifies them. See [[mvp-progression]], [[mvp-character-drivers]].

items.title: Richer community feedback in chat
items.body: Tag people (not too spammy), let players show off to each other. See [[mvp-social-model]], [[mvp-discord-ux]].

items.title: Use flash for quick responses/daily work, pro for decision trees
LLM latency: rein in reasoning length, tighten timeout+fallback
items.body: Deferred from polish-v0.2.8 (2026-07-04). Snapshot shows mean ~12.8s, 94 calls >20s, 26 >30s (max 47.5s); surfaces to players as timed_out/bailed outcomes. Overlaps the model-split item and thinking on/off experiments in [[mvp-llm-prompt-architecture]].

items.title: Auto-resolve roll refund: verify done path hands roll back on true no-op
items.body: Deferred from polish-v0.2.8. Bug reports say a `done` auto-resolve can consume a roll while doing nothing / not refund it (B#1, B#10). No-op/timeout/bail refund graces already exist and there is no deterministic double-decrement in `startAction`; verify the `done` path specifically. Part of the broader auto-resolve wound owned by the prompt refactor.

items.title: Saturday special: weekly scripted boss event + NPC death mutation
items.body: Minimal slice (one scripted weekly boss, shared HP) is now [[poc-plus-roadmap]] item 5; NPC death mutation and the wider event pool stay MVP.

items.title: Improved journal/story: quests, hints, clue system (+1 roll)
items.body: Track or show quests or hints; add a clue system that also grants +1 roll.
